raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 9, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscounted the studio albums in 2000–2009 by collapsing Cantora 1 and Cantora 2 (both listed as 2009 studio albums on Wikipedia) into a single “Cantora” entry, yielding 2 instead of the correct 3 (Corazón Libre 2005, Cantora 1 2009, Cantora 2 2009).
